hypotheses.hypothesis: Injecting 500ms network delay on the front-end service will cause the front-end home page to exceed the 15s timeout, violating the non-empty HTML contract.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: front-end is the entry point for all golden journey steps; no timeout/retry evidence for the home page.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: front-end home returns HTTP 200 with non-empty HTML within 15s.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject delay on service/front-end, then execute front-end home step and check HTTP status and response time.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Removing the delay restores normal response within washout period.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Injecting 100% network loss on the front-end service will cause all golden journey steps to fail, violating all contracts.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: front-end is the single entry point; no redundancy or fallback evidenced.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: All golden journey steps return expected HTTP statuses and contracts.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject loss on service/front-end, then execute all steps and verify failures.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Removing loss restores all steps within washout period.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the single front-end pod will cause the front-end service to have no available endpoints, failing all golden journey steps.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: single replica workload; no redundancy evidenced.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Kill the front-end pod, then execute all steps and verify failures.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Pod restart restores service within washout period.
